[.tooling/components/apis/rating-service/docs/README.md#-quick-start]

## 🚀 Quick Start

**New to the Rating Service?** Use our automated helper scripts:

```bash
# 1. Setup environment (one-time)
poetry run python _helpers/setup.py

# 2. Build service (one-time)
poetry run python _helpers/build.py

# 3. Start development server
poetry run python _helpers/run.py
```

**Service will be available at:**

- API: <http://localhost:8002>
- Docs: <http://localhost:8002/docs>
- Health: <http://localhost:8002/health>

**For detailed instructions, see:**

1. **[Getting Started Guide](getting-started.md)** - Complete setup walkthrough with helper script details
2. **[Architecture Overview](architecture.md#1-executive-summary)** - Understand what the service does and why it exists
3. **[API Specification](../README.md#-api-endpoints)** - Explore available endpoints and request/response formats

[.tooling/components/apis/rating-service/docs/README.md#-helper-scripts]

## 🛠️ Helper Scripts

The Rating Service includes automated helper scripts in the `_helpers/` directory for streamlined local development:
page_texts.15:
[.tooling/components/apis/rating-service/docs/README.md#setuppy---environment-setup]

### setup.py - Environment Setup

**Purpose**: One-time setup of development environment
**Usage**: `poetry run python _helpers/setup.py [--upgrade]`
**What it does**: Checks prerequisites, creates `.env`, installs dependencies, starts PostgreSQL
page_texts.16:
[.tooling/components/apis/rating-service/docs/README.md#buildpy---build--database]

### build.py - Build & Database

**Purpose**: Install dependencies and initialize database
**Usage**: `poetry run python _helpers/build.py`
**What it does**: Verifies PostgreSQL, installs dependencies, runs Alembic migrations
page_texts.17:
[.tooling/components/apis/rating-service/docs/README.md#runpy---development-server]

### run.py - Development Server

**Purpose**: Start FastAPI server with hot reload
**Usage**: `poetry run python _helpers/run.py`
**What it does**: Starts uvicorn on port 8002, auto-starts database if needed
page_texts.18:
[.tooling/components/apis/rating-service/docs/README.md#verifypy---code-quality]

### verify.py - Code Quality

**Purpose**: Comprehensive verification and testing
**Usage**: `poetry run python _helpers/verify.py [--fix|--verbose|--tests-only]`
**What it does**: Formatting, linting, security scanning, tests with coverage (80% minimum)

📋 See [Getting Started Guide](getting-started.md#%EF%B8%8F-helper-scripts-reference) for complete helper script documentation.

- ADR-001: Why FastAPI? (Performance, type safety, async)
- ADR-002: Why PostgreSQL? (JSONB, analytics, reliability)
- ADR-003: Why Alembic? (Version control, reversibility)
- ADR-004: Why AsyncPG? (3x performance improvement)
